description: Core 1.0 does not support the folded block scalar marker `>` — it is an ordinary unquoted string. The freetext line following it is not on the closed strict-error list (§10.1 only lists an empty inline slot's freetext-without-`|` as `null`/throw), so strict mode behaves identically to non-strict: the inline value is kept, the freetext line is silently skipped.
notes: Same input as core.block-scalar.folded-marker-unsupported.non-strict, asserting strict/non-strict parity — mirrors the closed-list regression guards core.strict-list.is-closed and core.document.unrecognized-line.skipped-both-modes.
